title: kitchen._on_sales_order_merged
description: Payload of the `sales.order.merged` event (contract of the sales module, SALES-F24): every unpaid line of `from_order_id` moved to `to_order_id` and `from_order_id` was voided, so its rounds now belong to `to_order_id` and close when that check is charged (kitchen#162). The event is also emitted on a refused merge and on every replay: the handler only re-points when the absorbed check IS voided (`reads` of `sales.order.get`). additionalProperties=true on purpose: the relay delivers the emitter's payload AS IS, `sender` included (kitchen#29). Idempotent: a redelivery finds nothing left on the absorbed check.
